features.title: slugify
features.description: Create src/slugify.ts exporting `export function slugify(input: string): string`. It lowercases the input, trims surrounding whitespace, replaces every run of one or more non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and removes leading and trailing hyphens. Examples: slugify('Hello, World!') === 'hello-world'; slugify('  Foo   Bar--Baz!! ') === 'foo-bar-baz'; slugify('') === ''; slugify('!!!wow!!!') === 'wow'.

features.title: truncate
features.description: Create src/truncate.ts exporting `export function truncate(input: string, max: number): string`. If input.length is less than or equal to max, return input unchanged; otherwise return the first max characters of input followed by a single ellipsis character '…' (U+2026). Examples: truncate('hi', 5) === 'hi'; truncate('hello', 5) === 'hello'; truncate('hello world', 5) === 'hello…'; truncate('abc', 0) === '…'.
